recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-7653; any desire to alter the exact THO EMER definition should be handled through terminology/UTG rather than core source reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-7653 was a Published/Not Persuasive with Modification PA change request asking whether Encounter.class should allow multiple values because outpatient/inpatient and emergency scenarios are not mutually exclusive. The final resolution kept class as encounter setting rather than urgency, pointed to Encounter.priority for priority, expected separate/related Encounters or class transitions for emergency-to-inpatient workflows, confirmed virtual visits were covered, and required the emergency class definition to change from urgent-care wording to an emergency-department/location concept.
initial_application: Commit 171fbc6b79cecfd1f0db542a6c3c827cb043c9dd explicitly applied the issue by changing the old Encounter spreadsheet emergency definition from 'An encounter where the patient needs urgent care' to 'An encounter in the Emergency Care Department.' The old spreadsheet source is no longer the current authoritative Encounter.class source.
additional_context: Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini, and current source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml defines Encounter.class as 0..* CodeableConcept with a preferred binding to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/encounter-class. Later Published PA decisions FHIR-32342 and FHIR-32341 intentionally changed Encounter.class to CodeableConcept, 0..*, and a preferred binding; those audits are already on the combined branch. FHIR-39147 later fixed the value set URL. Current THO terminology defines EMER as a dedicated emergency service location with possible discharge/admission/transfer and includes VR for virtual encounters.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current core source and terminology are already correct when the 2015 application and later PA decisions are considered, and adding old emergency wording to core narrative would be redundant and risk drifting from THO.
